entry.title: [要確認] pip: soapbar: verify_envelope_bsp accepts an unauthenticated embedded certificate (signature forgery / authentication bypass) (HIGH)
entry.content:
Claudeの仕分け：要確認 HIGH。soapbarの署名検証で埋め込み証明書を信じてしまい、署名の偽造や認証のすり抜けが起きる
→ soapbar を 0.13.0 以降に更新

soapbar < 0.13.0 → 0.13.0
